name: After § 78
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 78 a. Demands greater streamlining of the Union’s administrative services in order to eliminate duplication and reduce unnecessary costs; underlines that the savings thereby achieved should be redirected towards the Union’s strategic priorities, in particular border security, support for SMEs, agriculture, as well as research and innovation;
